We have an internal deadline of EOD Friday (4/28) to bundle everything for legal and the security review. Let me know if that timeline is feasible and who the internal point-of-contact will be.

Jamie — attaching the first draft of the control traceability workbook (radiant_sig_control_map_v1.xlsx). Notes on contents: 

- Tab layout: "Control Index" (SIG control id, our interpretation), "Evidence Links" (artifact ids and short description), "Owner" (internal team/contact), "Status" (Provided / Need follow-up / Not applicable).
- We've filled ~70% of the workbook with links to existing evidence in our assurance repository and included short excerpts where needed. Where an exact artifact is restricted (e.g., live audit logs), we flagged as "Need follow-up" and proposed either a redacted snapshot or an in-person review.
- For evidence types: config screenshots, policy PDFs, and jumpbox session logs are referenced. All artifacts have a one-line contextual note (why it satisfies the control).

Deliverables remaining: 
- Karthik to provide KMS rotation snapshot and brief on key scoping model (expected today).
- Final pass to harmonize filenames and compress into a single zip.

If you prefer a different column for your legal team (e.g., control maturity rating), tell me and we'll add it before finalizing.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@radianttech.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: KMS evidence snapshot + short technical note

Jamie — attaching the KMS snapshot PDF (kms_key_rotation_snapshot_20280424.pdf) and summarizing key points inline so your reviewers can triage quickly: 

- Snapshot content: curated export of rotation events for the customer master key used in Radiant's test tenant (timestamps in UTC, rotation request IDs, and resulting key version IDs). We included the signing hash and the audit event IDs.
- Scope: Redwood's hosted control plane separates customer key metadata from runtime key material; the rotation orchestration is performed by the KMS shim that uses customer-scoped envelope keys. Per your ask, the snapshot shows rotation events for the last 90 days.
- Redaction policy: We redacted raw HSM device identifiers and any session tokens. If Radiant needs deeper evidence (full audit stream), we can schedule an on-call review under an NDA/attestation workflow and provide time-limited access.

Next steps we propose: 
1) Jordan will bundle the workbook + PDF into a single delivery and upload to your Drive link.
2) If legal/security require an in-person review of raw logs, indicate the scope and we'll queue the evidence access playbook (usually a 48-72 hour lead time).

Attachment: kms_key_rotation_snapshot_20280424.pdf

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal, Security & Applied Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
